tagline: Three generations on the same route.

ownership.ownerSource: About page lists three generations; local newspaper profile from 2016 names all three principals.

yearsInBusiness.evidence: About page states 'Serving Marion County since 1987'; Earl Whitfield's signature on county business license records 1987.

services.name: Lawn Maintenance
services.description: Weekly and bi-weekly lawn service across Marion County. Same crew week after week.

services.name: Tree Trimming and Removal
services.description: Careful trim work and full removals. Neighborly cleanup after.

services.name: Irrigation Installation and Repair
services.description: System installs, zone repairs, controller replacements. We fix what we installed.

guarantees.type: same-crew service — you see the same faces week after week

testimonials.name: Dorothy K.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Earl started cutting my parents' grass in 1989. Danny took over when Earl's back gave out in the 2000s. Now Cole's out there doing it too. Thirty-six years of the same family on the same lot.
testimonials.quoteShort: Earl started cutting my parents' grass in 1989. Danny took over. Now Cole's out there too. Thirty-six years.

testimonials.name: Willie P.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Had a dead oak I wasn't sure what to do with. Danny came out and handled it in one afternoon. Wouldn't trust anyone else with a tree that big near the house.
testimonials.quoteShort: Dead oak handled in one afternoon. Wouldn't trust anyone else with a tree that big near the house.

testimonials.name: Norma J.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: My irrigation has been running on Riverside's install since 1998. Cole came out last spring and replaced the controller and two zone valves. Works like it did the day it was put in.
testimonials.quoteShort: Irrigation from 1998. Cole replaced the controller and two zones last spring. Works like the day it was put in.

testimonials.name: Raymond H.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Danny and Cole cut the grass, trim the hedges, and clean up after the storms. Same crew, same truck, same reliable work for twenty years. You don't find this anymore.
testimonials.quoteShort: Same crew, same truck, same reliable work for twenty years. You don't find this anymore.

testimonials.name: Ruth M.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Three generations of Whitfields have kept my yard looking like a yard. Earl is retired but still waves from the porch when the truck comes through.
testimonials.quoteShort: Three generations of Whitfields. Earl is retired but still waves from the porch when the truck comes through.
